system.description:
People are drawn to you, due to some characteristic appeal you exude. You may purchase additional Backgrounds using your Experience Traits at the end of each story more efficiently than usual.

System: This Merit allows the player to purchase more Backgrounds with Experience Traits. When the player purchases Traits in Allies, Contacts, Herd or Retainers, he may gain two Background Traits per Experience Trait spent. Storytellers should watch this Merit carefully for potential abuse.
